content: Intelligence is dangerous. Intelligence means you will start thinking on your own; you will start looking around on your own.
author: Osho
sourceWork: Meditation: The First and Last Freedom
story:
From the university lecture halls of Jabalpur to the bustling ashram in Pune, Osho challenged institutional dogmas, religious orthodoxies, and societal hypocrisies. Synthesizing Zen, Sufism, Tantra, and Western therapy, he introduced dynamic meditation techniques designed to shake modern individuals out of obsessive mental chatter into spontaneous, authentic aliveness.

In formulating this reflection, Osho stripped away superficial conventions to address the core anatomy of intelligence. For Osho, true wisdom is never an abstract luxury, but an urgent practical discipline required to navigate life with clarity and unshakeable dignity.
reflectionPrompt: What would change in your daily outlook if you truly lived by this perspective?
